summary: Modified ExtensionHostService to accept a per-workspace integration resolver, wired it through server.ts to consult ProjectCatalog for enabled integrations, and updated the host-service test to cover descriptor id matching and provider filtering.
decisions: ExtensionHostService constructor now accepts an `integrationIdsFor` resolver used to filter providers to only those whose integration id is enabled for the workspace, passed from server.ts via ProjectCatalog.integrationsFor.

Server configures the host with a 5_000ms poll and async resolver returning integration ids per workspace path: `new ExtensionHostService(extensions, 5_000, async (workspacePath) => (await projects.integrationsFor(workspacePath)).map(({ id }) => id))`.
Test for ExtensionHostService now imports `vi`, adds a case asserting `host.list` does not call the provider when no ids match, and `new ExtensionHostService([provider], 5_000, async () => [])`.

ProjectCatalog now normalizes stored profile overrides against detected/default templates on save and read: `reconcileProfiles(stored, templates)` drops overrides whose values match canonical defaults, keeping only deltas.
errors: `rg` against `apps/app/src/lib/features/workspace/WorkspaceInspector.svelte` failed with ENOENT (os error 2); the file actually lives at `apps/app/src/lib/extensions/WorkspaceInspector.svelte`, which `find` later located.
